title: SvgFePointLight
responsibility: Renders the native fePointLight element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgFePointLight.children
inputs.description: Optional Svelte snippet rendered as child content inside the native fePointLight element when provided; when omitted, the component renders no child content.

outputs.name: SvgFePointLight
outputs.description: The component renders one native SVG fePointLight element and spreads all props other than children onto it. If children is provided, it is rendered inside the element; no wrapper is added.
